automatable_note: A jumper must be fitted and removed by hand during every program. The bench cannot do this.

manual.action: Fit the jumper on the programming contacts.
Pull the jumper off as soon as the drive battery is connected.
Current limit and reset: fit the jumper again while the ESC beeps, as the program asks.

entry.confirm_signal: Signal after jumper removal; 3-fold or 4-fold signal after about 5 s; 6-fold signal about 30 s after reset beeps.
steps: Receiver battery connected on ESC types without BEC. Transmitter on.

Stick-way teach-in: throttle to brake or motor-off (stick back), operator fits the jumper and turns on the radio; apply drive power and pull the jumper; one signal; move to full; one signal; for EMK brake move to motor-off (may equal brake); for a start button fit the jumper again; two signals; disconnect power.

Brake strength: same start; apply power and pull the jumper; a signal; wait about 5 s for the 4-fold signal; count the beeps (10 % each); move the throttle out of the brake position at the wanted count; the ESC repeats the strength; disconnect power.

Current limit: throttle at full, jumper on, radio on; apply power and pull the jumper; a signal; wait about 5 s for the 3-fold signal; count the beeps (5 A each); move the throttle out of full at the wanted count; the ESC repeats the value; fit the jumper again for current regulation; two signals; disconnect power.

Reset: any throttle position; fit the jumper and turn on the radio; apply power and fit/keep the jumper while the ESC beeps several times; about 30 s after the last signal a 6-fold signal arrives; the LED flashes continuously; disconnect power.

announce.description: After the wait signal, the ESC sounds one beep per unit (5 A for the current limit, 10 % for the brake strength); the throttle movement at the wanted count stores it, and the ESC repeats the stored value.

select.description: Current limit: move the throttle out of full. Brake strength: move it out of the brake position.

skip.description: Disconnect power to abandon a program.

scheme.confirm_signal: The ESC repeats the stored value as beeps; two signals after the jumper is replugged for current regulation or the start button.
scheme.reset_to_defaults: Reset program: jumper on, power on, about 30 s later a 6-fold signal, LED flashes continuously.
scheme.description: Four separate programs on a jumper-and-signals scheme. The throttle position at power-up and the signal count the ESC reaches select the program. Settings are taught by moving the stick.

items.name: Stick positions (brake / motor-off, full) with optional EMK brake and start button

values.name: taught by the sequence; EMK brake on if the throttle goes to motor-off after the full signal
each beep counted = 5 A; throttle leaves full at the wanted count
each beep counted = 10 % brake strength; throttle leaves brake at the wanted count

items.name: Reset to auto-programming mode and undervoltage cutoff on/off (6-fold signal)

values.name: reset: about 30 s after the last signal a 6-fold signal arrives; the LED flashes continuously
undervoltage cutoff off: pull the jumper during the reset sequence

unknowns: Signal is an LED flash plus a beep with the motor connected; beep duration and gaps are not stated.
Time allowed between steps is not stated except the 'about 5 s' wait for the 3-fold or 4-fold signal and about 30 s for the reset.
How the ESC decides between stick-way teach-in and brake-strength entry when both start with the stick back and the jumper pulled at power-up is not stated in the text.
Item numbers are the signal counts where the manual gives them; item 1 is the stick-way teach-in, which has no count.
Input and rating of CYOPT types are not stated in the text read.
notes: The Cyber-Line manual replaces the CPS-only extras (cutoff per cell, reducing instead of cutting) with PC programming; the stick scheme here does not reach them.
